\section{Overview}

Declarations of the Lean module \texttt{TCSlib.Complexity.RAMSimulation.Simulation}.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Word RAM simulation time]
\lean{WordRAM.simTime}
\label{WordRAM.simTime}
\leanok
For natural numbers $A,n,W,t,f$ and a function $T_W : \bbn \to \bbn$, define the
simulation time to be $T_W(n)+A(t+1)\bigl(f(W+1)+W^2+n+1\bigr)$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Simulation space bound]
\lean{WordRAM.simSpace}
\label{WordRAM.simSpace}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.logSpace}
For natural numbers $A,n,W,f$ and a function $S_W : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, define
the simulation space to be
$S_W(n)+A\bigl(f(W+1)+W+\operatorname{Complexity.logSpace}(n)+1\bigr)$, where
$\operatorname{Complexity.logSpace}(n)$ denotes the logarithmic space quantity
associated with input size $n$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Boolean-list output selection]
\lean{WordRAM.outputOf}
\label{WordRAM.outputOf}
\leanok
Given Boolean values $f$ and $v$ and a Boolean list $o$, the output is $o$ when $f$ is
true and the singleton list containing $v$ when $f$ is false.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Simulation of extended word RAM programs]
\lean{WordRAM.exists_simulation}
\label{WordRAM.exists_simulation}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.FinTM, Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime, Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.WordSizeComputable, WordRAM.XProgram, WordRAM.outputOf, WordRAM.simSpace, WordRAM.simTime}
Let $W,TW,SW:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be functions, and suppose there is a finite-state
Turing machine that, on every Boolean input $x$, halts within some time $t_x\le
TW(|x|)$, outputs the binary representation of $W(|x|)$, and uses at most $SW(|x|)$
space. For every extended word RAM program $P$ and Boolean value $fn$, there are a
finite-state Turing machine $M$ and a natural number $A$ such that the following holds
for every Boolean input $x$, natural numbers $t,f$, Boolean value $v$, and Boolean
string $o$: if $P$, run on $x$ with an empty coin sequence and word width $W(|x|)$,
halts after $n<t$ steps, touches at most $f$ memory addresses, returns $v$, and has
emitted string $o$, then $M$ outputs $o$ when $fn$ is true and the one-bit string $[v]$
when $fn$ is false. It does so in exactly $TW(|x|)+A(t+1)(f(W(|x|)+1)+W(|x|)^2+|x|+1)$
steps and uses at most $SW(|x|)+A(f(W(|x|)+1)+W(|x|)+\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+2)$ space.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Nondeterministic simulation of an extended word RAM]
\lean{WordRAM.exists_ndSimulation}
\label{WordRAM.exists_ndSimulation}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.FinNDTM.AcceptsWithin, Turing.NDTM.HaltsWithin, Turing.NDTM.initCfg, Turing.NDTM.spaceUsedWith, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.WordSizeComputable, WordRAM.XProgram, WordRAM.simSpace, WordRAM.simTime}
Let $P$ be an extended word RAM program, and let $W,TW,SW:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be
functions such that some finite deterministic Turing machine, on every Boolean input
$x$, outputs the $W(|x|)$-bit representation of $W(|x|)$ within $TW(|x|)$ steps and uses
exactly $SW(|x|)$ work-tape cells. Then there are a finite nondeterministic Turing
machine $N$ and a natural number $A$ such that, for every Boolean input $x$ and all
$t,f\in\mathbb{N}$, if for every coin sequence $\rho$ there are a Boolean value and an
output string for which $P$ halts on $x$ with word width $W(|x|)$, in fewer than $t$
steps, touching at most $f$ memory addresses, then every length-$s$ choice sequence
makes $N$ halt on $x$ within $s=TW(|x|)+A(t+1)(f(W(|x|)+1)+W(|x|)^2+|x|+1)$ steps and
use at most $SW(|x|)+A(f(W(|x|)+1)+W(|x|)+\lceil\log_2(|x|+1)\rceil+1)$ work-tape cells.
Moreover, $N$ accepts on $x$ within $s$ steps if and only if there exist a coin sequence
$\rho$ and an output string $o$ such that $P$ halts with Boolean result true and output
$o$ on $x$ with word width $W(|x|)$, in fewer than $t$ steps, touching at most $f$
memory addresses.
\end{theorem}
